name: Quote Share Box
author: AppZoic

sections.description:
Easily display inspiring quotes, testimonials, or important text snippets on your WordPress site with the Quote Share Box plugin. This lightweight plugin provides a simple shortcode to wrap your content in a professionally styled blockquote and encourages user engagement by allowing them to easily copy the quote and share it on popular social platforms.

Key Features:

  • Simple Shortcode: Use the [appzoic_quote] shortcode to wrap any text and turn it into a styled quote.
  • Copy to Clipboard: Users can copy the quote text to their clipboard with a single click.
  • Social Sharing: One-click sharing buttons for Facebook, WhatsApp, and Telegram help your content go viral.
  • Clean Design: Modern, responsive design that looks great on all devices.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Uses efficient code and a CDN for Font Awesome icons to minimize performance impact.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the quote-share-box folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [appzoic_quote]Your inspirational quote goes here![/appzoic_quote] in your posts, pages, or widgets.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Simply wrap the text you want to display as a quote with the shortcode: [appzoic_quote]Your text here...[/appzoic_quote].

Can I change the style/colors of the quote box?

Yes, but it requires custom CSS. The main quote container has the class .quote-container-appzoic, and the buttons are within .share-buttons-appzoic. You can add your own CSS to your theme’s stylesheet to override the default styles.

Which social networks are supported?

The plugin currently supports sharing for Facebook, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

Does the plugin work with the Gutenberg editor?

Yes, you can add the shortcode using the “Shortcode” block in the Gutenberg (Block) editor.
